title: Privacy Policy
description: How SUPUZZ collects, uses and protects personal information on supuzz.com, including newsletter subscriptions, contact forms and anonymous analytics.
contactLine: Questions about this policy? Contact us at

sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: This policy explains what personal information SUPUZZ collects when you visit supuzz.com, how we use it, and the choices you have. SUPUZZ is a brand website for building toys and kids furniture; product purchases take place on Amazon.com and are governed by Amazon's own policies.

sections.heading: Information we collect
paragraphs: When you subscribe to our newsletter, we collect your email address and the language of the page you subscribed from. When you send a message through the contact form, we collect the name, email address and details you provide.
We also collect anonymous usage data, such as pages visited, approximate time spent and a randomly generated visitor identifier, to understand how the site is used.

sections.heading: How we use information
paragraphs: We use your email address to send the newsletter you requested, including play ideas, new-product news and special offers, and to respond to your inquiries. Anonymous usage data is used in aggregate to improve the website.

sections.heading: Cookies and local storage
paragraphs: The site may store a small language-preference cookie and a visitor identifier in your browser's local storage. These help us keep the site in your preferred language and measure aggregate usage. They do not identify you personally.

sections.heading: Sharing
paragraphs: We do not sell your personal information. We may share information with service providers who help us operate the website and deliver emails (for example, a newsletter platform), only as needed to provide those services. Links to Amazon.com are provided for purchases; information you provide to Amazon is subject to Amazon's privacy policy.

sections.heading: Your choices
paragraphs: You can unsubscribe from the newsletter at any time using the link in any email we send. To access, correct or delete your information, or to ask a question, contact us using the address below.

sections.heading: Children
paragraphs: This website is intended for adults, such as parents and educators. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.
